Title: General availability: Azure Monitor for Azure Virtual Desktop

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor for Azure Virtual Desktop provides you a 360 degree view of your Azure Virtual Desktop environment. You can easily find and troubleshoot problems in the deployment, view the status and health of host pools, diagnose session issues, and understand resource utilization. General availability comes with many improvements including improved data collection and setup experience and cost optimizations.

Learn more.
